summary: Established a robust architectural governance framework, including AST-based parsing, deterministic model pinning, and an Idempotent Execution Guard. Implemented a 'DiversityEnforcer' to prevent planning drift and a 12-wave domain rotation strategy to mitigate technical debt, all while refining the 1% growth metric to prioritize measurable architectural output over volume-based tasks.
key_learnings: AST-based parsing and model version pinning are critical for maintaining system determinism and structural integrity.
Semantic vector analysis (DiversityEnforcer) prevents echo-chamber planning, while domain rotation prevents local optimization and technical atrophy.
Aligning internal growth metrics with specific architectural milestones provides more accurate evidence of progress than generic task completion.
